exec: Investor interest in securing AI agents continues; an early-stage round with no operational impact.
plain: WhiteMatter, a security company formerly called QuilrAI, raised $20 million to build products that protect AI assistants that act on a company's behalf. Its total funding is now $24 million.
summary: WhiteMatter, a security company formerly called QuilrAI, raised $20 million to build products that protect AI assistants that act on a company's behalf. Blumberg Capital led the Series A, bringing total funding to $24 million.
title: WhiteMatter (formerly QuilrAI) raises $20 million for AI agent security
